description.value: Thunderbird Show Park is one of North America's premier equestrian event facilities, hosting ten weeks of internationally recognized hunter and jumper tournaments each year just east of Vancouver in Langley. The park welcomes everyone from first-time junior amateur competitors to world-class FEI Grand Prix athletes, and spectators can watch show jumping from the grandstands alongside restaurants, bars, and boutique shops on site. The venue is large enough to accommodate RVs and hosts a dedicated spectator entrance on 248th Street separate from the competitor and show office entrance.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Thunderbird Show Park is an active, major equestrian event facility in Langley, BC, hosting FEI-recognized competitions. The website explicitly mentions 'an array of restaurants, bars and boutique shops' confirming on-site food service. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so all required criteria and most optional amenities remain null. OSM and website agree on the main show office address and website URL; the phone number was sourced from the website footer as OSM carried no phone.
concerns: Venue has two publicly listed addresses: spectator entrance at 6975 248th St, Langley, BC and main show office at 24550 72 Ave, Langley, BC V1M 3W8. OSM records the show office address; arriving cyclists as spectators should use the 248th St entrance.
OSM carried no phone number; phone sourced from website footer only.
No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; all required criteria are unverifiable without direct contact or site visit.
